name: アイコン付き設定リンクグループ
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0002 アイコン付き設定リンクグループ.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render ONE compact three-row settings link group, based ONLY on the original's FIRST group (normalized x16,y134,w358,h134; original pixel crop x48,y405,w1082,h405). Preserve our Japanese labels, top to bottom: 表示の種類 / 画面のカスタマイズ / 通知の設定. All are Meiryo Regular logical 14px, line height24px, tracking0. No title. No additional rows. At left, reconstruct the ORIGINAL icons precisely: first a shallow inbox tray outline with a small central inset/notch; second the same inbox tray with a tiny gear at its lower right; third a simple envelope outline with V-shaped flap. Do NOT use the mock's envelope/standalone gear/bell sequence. Source icons live in matching small rounded green tiles as one coherent settings group; adapt all three tile backgrounds to subtle forest-green brand gradient with white glyphs. Align consistent optical weight and shared tile size. Three Japanese labels align vertically and have comfortable left gap from icon. At right, use the original's small light-neutral right chevrons (two connected strokes, not text greater-than signs); thin inset separators begin at the label column. White rounded outer group on pure-white canvas, no mint/gray page panel. Keep the compact logical358px-wide group with about44–48px rows, enlarged uniformly for readable output. Render wide around1536x700 with restrained white margin; no surrounding settings header, section labels or phone chrome.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Retain the original's coherent green group indication, adapted to the forest-green brand gradient on all three equal icon tiles. White source glyphs stay consistent; subdued neutral chevrons/dividers. No random per-icon colors.
reviewNotes: 原版全体と対象crop比較を目視。保存モックの封筒・歯車・ベルという代用図形を修正し、原版のトレー・トレーと歯車・封筒を優先。原版の緑色は同グループの意味を持ち、3個共通の森緑タイルへ適応。日本語3項目、行順、区切り、右シェブロン、白面、余白、影を生成後目視確認。厳密なglyph/フォント同一性、実操作、native編集、所有者承認は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
